meta.title: The studio: approach, method and team
meta.description: Kodexa is a web studio that designs and develops digital solutions for businesses. Learn about our philosophy, our technical approach and how we work.

title: Building isn't just writing code.
lead: First you have to understand the problem, the business and the people who will use it. Kodexa exists to solve something clear: businesses that need to grow but are held back by poorly built digital solutions that don't scale.
philosophyTitle: Three ideas that shape every project.
techTitle: Technology in service of the business.
techLead: We choose tools based on what the project needs, not the other way around. We work with modern, maintainable technology, focused on performance, structure and evolution.
